title.narrative: Solomon Islands Democratic Governance and Electoral Assistance Project

description.narrative: The Solomon Islands Democratic Governance and Electoral Assistance Project (2026–2029) supports the Government of Solomon Islands and the Solomon Islands Elections Commission (SIEC) in strengthening the integrity, inclusiveness, and effectiveness of the electoral cycle leading to the 2028 joint national, provincial, and local elections. Building on the successful conduct of the 2024 Joint Elections and informed by the 2025 UN Electoral Needs Assessment Mission and the final evaluation of the SECSIP III programme, the project focuses on enhancing the institutional capacity of electoral management bodies, supporting targeted legal and regulatory reforms, promoting inclusive political participation—particularly for women, youth, and persons with disabilities—and strengthening electoral integrity. The project also supports the assessment and initiation of an integrated legal identity and national identification system to improve the accuracy and sustainability of voter data, as well as the establishment of SIEC provincial offices to decentralise electoral services and bring them closer to communities, contributing to Sustainable Development Goals 5 and 16 and to more accountable, inclusive, and resilient democratic governance in Solomon Islands.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
